description: This file contains Redux Saga generator functions for handling user settings updates, including profile info, social links, sound preferences, certification verification, and layout resets in a FreeCodeCamp project.

methods.name: submitNewAboutSaga
methods.description: Handles submitting new 'About' information, updates state, and shows flash message.

methods.name: submitNewUsernameSaga
methods.description: Handles username change, updates state, navigates to new profile URL, and shows flash message.

methods.name: submitProfileUISaga
methods.description: Handles profile UI updates, updates state, and shows flash message.

methods.name: updateMySocialsSaga
methods.description: Updates user social links and shows flash message.

methods.name: updateMySoundSaga
methods.description: Updates sound preferences in store and state, shows flash message.

methods.name: resetMyEditorLayoutSaga
methods.description: Resets editor layout, removes stored layout, and shows flash message.

methods.name: updateMyKeyboardShortcutsSaga
methods.description: Updates keyboard shortcuts and shows flash message.

methods.name: updateMyHonestySaga
methods.description: Updates honesty setting and shows flash message.

methods.name: updateMyQuincyEmailSaga
methods.description: Updates Quincy email and shows flash message.

methods.name: updateMyPortfolioSaga
methods.description: Updates portfolio info and shows flash message.

methods.name: updateMyExperienceSaga
methods.description: Updates experience info and shows flash message.

methods.name: validateUsernameSaga
methods.description: Validates if username exists and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: verifyCertificationSaga
methods.description: Verifies certification completion, performs client-side validation, and updates state.

methods.name: createSettingsSagas
methods.description: Creates an array of saga watchers for various user settings actions.
